maxVelocityLimit.description: Maximum ball speed. Higher values make the game faster and more difficult.

minVelocityLimit.description: Minimum ball speed. Lower values mean the ball can travel more slowly.

timeBounceBall.description: Time delay for ball bounces. Higher values make physics slightly more relaxed.

maxBallSpawn.description: Maximum number of balls spawned when collecting a multi-ball power-up.
